en: The black-and-white image shows an aerial view of a formal public square with ornate gardens and two prominent monuments. The central monument appears to be a tall, sculpted column with several figures, possibly a fountain or commemorative statue. In the foreground, there is a large equestrian statue on a pedestal. The square is surrounded by stone paths, benches, and a border of low stone walls. The architecture in the background is grand, multi-story, and likely European, with classical detailing. People are walking, sitting, and gathering in various parts of the square.
